evidence: Clementine Matthew 1:5 ends Jesse autem genuit David regem; 1:6 begins David autem rex genuit Salomonem. https://www.biblehub.com/vul/matthew/1.htm
Douay-Rheims 1899 Matthew 1:6 begins And Jesse begot David the king. Its following sentence translates Clementine 1:6. https://ebible.org/engDRA/MAT01.htm
rationale: Display existing English occurrences with the matching Clementine passage while preserving both complete published English verses. Intervals are zero-based, end-exclusive. The 37 English occurrences across both units are assigned once across the two pages in their original edition order. This concordance and its word grouping were prepared by Codex from the declared editions; independent scholarly review remains separate.
